title: GeometryPatch
description: AUXILIARY G4 ARM ONLY (design 2026-09-24 section 9.2). A geometry-only repair: new global XY positions for staging configurations named in the geometry context the arm was shown. Rotation and height are preserved; nothing else can be expressed. The main arms (U1/U4/V4) never use this schema -- their output is tool_proposal.schema.json. tools/monitor/repair_geometry_control.jl validates it with the same RepairTypes subset validator and turns each write into an engine call on that exact configuration; it computes no coordinates of its own.
